description: This file contains the PHP class 'Article' within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Cms. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and form rendering for CMS articles in the OpenCart admin panel, including methods for displaying articles, processing form submissions, and managing related data such as descriptions, images, authors, topics, stores, and breadcrumbs.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing CMS articles in the admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting articles, along with handling related data such as descriptions, images, author info, topics, and store associations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for handling the listing and redirecting to the appropriate view based on the request.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the article list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of articles based on filter parameters and prepares data for the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of articles, likely via response.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an article, pre-filling data if editing an existing article.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of an article, handling both adding and editing, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected articles.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Handles article rating view and processing, including fetching rating data, updating ratings, and pagination.
